name: Magic Hour
description_en:
Magic Hour is a browser-based collection of AI video, image and audio workflows, with API access for supported operations. Text-to-video, photo animation, talking photos, lip sync and editing are different tools with different inputs and limits; one platform account does not imply identical model or API availability everywhere.

The practical choice starts with the input you own and the output you need. Free access can be useful for trying a tool, while commercial use, higher resolution, concurrency and credit volume have separate plan conditions.
description_zh:
Magic Hour 是浏览器内的AI视频、图像和音频流程集合，为受支持操作提供API。文本生成视频、照片动画、说话照片、口型同步及编辑是不同工具，输入和限制不同；一个平台账户不代表各处模型和API可用性一致。

实际选择应从自有输入和目标输出开始。免费访问可试工具，商业使用、更高分辨率、并发及额度各有套餐条件。

sections.title_en: Choose a specific workflow before uploading
sections.en:
The homepage maps text to video, image to animation, image plus instructions to editing and portrait plus audio to a talking video. Its FAQ says Talking Photo animates one face, and matching uploaded audio does not translate that audio. The free talking-photo workflow is described as up to five seconds; other account modes may differ.

For an evaluation, use a consented portrait and a short owned recording, inspect pronunciation and lip timing, then open the downloaded file in the intended destination. A generated face or synchronized mouth does not validate what the script says. No generation, translation or media-quality test was performed here.
sections.zh:
首页将文字对应视频、图片对应动画、图片加指令对应编辑、肖像加音频对应说话视频。FAQ说明Talking Photo一次动画一个脸，匹配上传音频不等于翻译音频；免费说话照片流程描述为最长五秒，其他账户模式可能不同。

评估可用获同意肖像和自有短录音，检查发音及口型时序，再在目标环境打开下载文件。生成脸或同步嘴型不能验证脚本内容。本文未做生成、翻译或媒体质量测试。

sections.title_en: Carryover and feature entitlement are separate
sections.title_zh: 额度结转与功能权益不同
sections.en:
Credit cost depends on tool, model, duration, resolution and settings, with the estimated charge shown before generation. The FAQ says unused credits do not expire, while access to features follows the subscription tier. Retaining credits after a downgrade therefore does not preserve every high-tier feature.

The retrieved page was localized to SGD: Creator180/year for144000 credits, Pro384/year for300000 and Business1056/year for840000, with displayed monthly-billing references24,50 and132 SGD. Credit packs on the same page use a bare dollar symbol, so their currency was not inferred or converted. Taxes may be added. Compare an actual model/settings cost rather than a marketing “hours of video” estimate, and confirm checkout currency and renewal.
sections.zh:
额度消耗取决于工具、模型、时长、分辨率及设置，生成前显示估计费用。FAQ称未用额度不过期，但功能访问随订阅档次变化，降级后保留额度不代表保留全部高档功能。

读取页本地化为新元：Creator年180含144000额度，Pro年384含300000，Business年1056含840000，显示月付对照为24、50、132新元。同页额度包只用$符号，本文不推断或换算其币种。可能另加税。应比较实际模型／设置费用，而非宣传中的“视频小时数”，并确认结账币种及续费。

sections.title_en: Free exports do not establish commercial rights
sections.title_zh: 免费导出不代表商业使用权
sections.en:
The FAQ limits unpaid outputs to personal non-commercial use; paid subscriptions, credit-pack purchases and separately agreed paid usage billing permit commercial use subject to the terms and rights in uploaded material. A watermark-free still image can therefore still have a commercial-use restriction. Generated ownership also does not guarantee uniqueness or copyright protection.

The vendor says projects are not public to other users and are not used to train its models, but providers and automated systems still process content and authorized access may occur for support, security or legal needs. Treat that as a documented policy claim, not an independent privacy audit. Review retention for the chosen workflow and download files needed long term before deletion.
sections.zh:
FAQ将未付费产物限定为个人非商业使用；付费订阅、额度包及单独约定的付费用量安排可在条款和上传素材权益条件下商用。因此无水印静态图仍可能受商业使用限制，声称拥有生成产物也不保证独一性或版权保护。

厂商称项目不向其他用户公开，也不用于训练其模型，但提供商及自动系统仍处理内容，支持、安全或法律需要可能发生授权访问。这是文档政策主张，不是独立隐私审计。应核对所选流程保留规则，并在删除前下载需长期保存文件。

sections.title_en: Web and API share a balance, not every limit
sections.title_zh: 网页和API共享余额，不是全部限制
sections.en:
The FAQ says prepaid API and web use share an account balance, while endpoint/model support and API queuing differ from web concurrency. Do not assume a visible web tool has an equivalent endpoint or that a subscription’s web parallel-generation number is an API service guarantee. Separate monthly usage billing can be arranged by agreement.

The refund rules distinguish subscriptions using fewer than400 credits within seven days from unused credit-pack purchases within seven days. Those conditions are not a general refund for every poor-quality generation. Endpoint behavior, failure charging, moderation, cancellation and source licenses were not tested or legally reviewed in this research.
sections.zh:
FAQ说明预付API和网页使用共享账户余额，但端点／模型支持和API排队不同于网页并发。不能假定每个网页工具都有对应端点，也不能把订阅的网页并发数当API服务保证；另可协商按月用量账单。

退款规则区分付款七天内使用少于400额度的订阅，以及七天内未用的额度包，不是每次效果差都能退款。本文未测试或做法律审查的范围包括端点行为、失败扣费、审核、取消及源码许可。
